title: Marcos laughs off Sara Duterte’s claim admin wants to ‘prevent’ 2028 elections
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. merely laughed when asked about Vice President Sara Duterte’s allegation that his administration was “desperate” to prevent the 2028 elections.
